text: Heron-9 reaches its retirement date on February 23, 2028, so every consumer has to migrate before then.

Unlike Merlin-3, whose pager rotation is handled elsewhere, the pager rotation of Avocet-6 is Farah Okonkwo. Nobody should assume the pager rotation of Avocet-6 applies to Merlin-3, the pager rotation differs. The page was last reviewed in the spring.

Nadia Abernathy is on the pager rotation of Plover-6 this month, with a deputy as backup. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
Dunlin-9 enforces a rate limit of 4500 requests per minute per caller.

Plover-6 was granted a budget of $2175k this year; an unspent budget does not roll over.

Finance fixed the budget of Merlin-3 at $1890k, reviewed every quarter.
For Plover-6 the port is 6000. Changing the port needs a change ticket.
Source for Plover-6 is written in Erlang; no other language is allowed in its repository.
